<description>
This PR changes `-acceptnonstdtxn=1` so that it also skips the non-mandatory script checks, allowing txs that (eg) use OP_NOPx or OP_SUCCESS into the mempool. This remains only available on test nets.
</description>

I don't think restricting the structure of `GetBlockScriptFlags` like that is a good idea; you can see the knots [BIP110/RDTS deployment logic](https://github.com/bitcoinknots/bitcoin/blob/58398baf33e588779685ead478e6397bb28ed3d6/src/validation.cpp#L2756-L2761) for one (not necessarily very good) example where continuing with that structure was avoided.

I've bumped the PR with mostly the same logic but defining a `ConsensusScriptVerifyFlags` class instead, which may come across as easier to follow.
